hypotheses.statement: Nintendo EPD is the developer with the most sales and is above the mean sales per developer.
hypotheses.evidence: Nintendo EPD: 162.15 M copies in 14 titles (55.5 % of all sales), 13.3 x the developer mean of 12.18 M. Only 4 of 24 developers are above the mean: Nintendo EPD, Game Freak, Bandai Namco Studios, NDcube.

hypotheses.statement: Platformer is the genre with the most sales and role-playing the genre with the most titles.
hypotheses.evidence: Top genre by sales: Platformer (52.70 M, 18.0 %). Top genre by titles: Platformer (7) vs 4 labelled 'Role-playing'. If action and tactical RPGs are grouped, the role-playing family has 9 titles and 47.75 M copies.

hypotheses.statement: Third-party companies have far fewer best-selling titles than first/second-party companies.
hypotheses.evidence: First/second party: 34 titles (79.1 %) and 93.7 % of sales; third party: 9 titles. Median sales per title 3.05 M vs 2.00 M (Mann-Whitney U = 223, one-sided p = 0.0190).

hypotheses.statement: Most titles sell more than the mean of the list.
hypotheses.evidence: Only 14 of 43 titles (32.6 %) exceed the mean of 6.80 M. The distribution is right-skewed (skewness 1.77); the median is 2.87 M and the top 10 titles hold 67.8 % of all sales.
